path_definitions.off: Unmodified embedded X; its own graph; no TIID. Reproduce native incident_data=None.
path_definitions.norm_only: LayerNorm at every node of latest embedded X; its own graph; no incident V and no TIID.
path_definitions.icsf_only: Native ICSF including LayerNorm; its own graph; no TIID.
path_definitions.tiid_only: Same history and graph as norm_only; native TIID uses original report context.
path_definitions.full: Native ICSF history and graph plus native TIID. Reproduce native fixed A.
path_definitions.full_norm_graph: Same ICSF history and TIID as full; replay norm_only dynamic graph with shared static graph. Conditional sensitivity diagnostic.

synthetic_probe: Copy ICSF weights; 2 samples, 12 steps, 4 nodes, fixed mixed support. Probe scalar projection gradients, history change, same-support distance change and zero support. No Y and no optimizer.
output: Per-cohort sample/region sums, counts and maxima in NPZ, synthetic diagnostics, summary, hashes, host/PID/progress. Atomic publication from a .partial directory.
interpretation: Fixed-weight path sensitivities on reused training data. Components can interact and removals can be out of distribution. No causal attribution, independent confirmation, performance win, variance-explained percentage or additive MAE attribution. Check mode verifies engineering only.
